rule.description: A method of one locally declared class reads the instance data of another locally declared wiring-record class through a parameter, loop binding, callback binding, or local — at least 4 reads across at least 3 distinct fields, and at least 3 times the method's own-state reads — instead of that record owning the behavior. Calls on any receiver are collaboration rather than data reads, interface-typed receivers are data transfer rather than mining, same-class receivers and constructors are excluded.

checks.description: A method of an operator class repeatedly mines the instance data of one wiring-record class (BindingDigest or ContainerSnapshot) while holding little or no relevant state of its own.
checks.detected_relation: operator class method -> envied wiring record fields
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The behavior's result is defined entirely by the record's data — its formatting vocabulary, classification rules, comparison precedence, payload inventory, or status wording — yet it is implemented away from that data, so every change to the record's meaning must be mirrored in a foreign helper.

matches.evidence: serialize builds the JSON payload by copying digest bindingType, hasActivation, hasDeactivation, name, scope, serviceIdentifier, and a spread of tagNames from a map callback binding, plus the snapshot's containerLabel and defaultScope.

diff walks the current snapshot's digests through a for-of loop binding, reads each digest's serviceIdentifier twice plus scope and bindingType for added-registration descriptions, and reads the baseline digest collection through its snapshot parameter.

describeRegistrationChange compares two digests field by field (scope, bindingType, name, tagNames.length, hasActivation) and renders before/after fragments, mining the previous digest through a direct parameter while holding no own state.
computeScopeBreakdown derives the grouping key from each digest reached by iterating the snapshot's digest collection: scope, bindingType, and the hasActivation/hasDeactivation lifecycle suffix.
countStatefulRegistrations classifies each digest reached through a for-of binding as stateful using its scope, bindingType, hasActivation, and hasDeactivation fields.

render assembles the report from the snapshot passed as a parameter: containerLabel header, defaultScope line, iteration over the digest collection for rows, and the digests length for the registered-services total.
renderDigest formats one registration row by reading the digest parameter's serviceIdentifier, scope, bindingType, name, hasActivation, hasDeactivation, and tagNames with no own-state involvement.

renderBindingLegend reads the digest parameter's serviceIdentifier, scope, bindingType, hasActivation, and hasDeactivation to build the legend sentences explaining what the registration means for resolution.

describeRuntimeStatus reads six digest fields (serviceIdentifier, scope, bindingType, hasActivation, hasDeactivation) to narrate bound/unbound status, consulting the live container only through a single isBound call on its one own field.

excluded.reason: Integration with the DigestLineWriter sink port: it forwards each identifier and only reads the digest serviceIdentifier once; data transfer to a consumer port is not record mining.
Reads a narrow qualifier slice (tagNames and name) that stays below the rule's minimum of 3 distinct mined fields, so it is not credited; repairing it remains allowed.
Only two shallow reads of the digest serviceIdentifier; the substantive dependency consults the live container through isBound calls, which is delegation.

Its receivers are typed by the DigestPayload and SnapshotPayload interfaces: external JSON interchange contracts, which is data transfer into records, not mining of record state. The parse helper and the module-level isSnapshotPayload guard are excluded for the same reason.
